tools.name: mm_info
tools.description: Networks, contract addresses, fees, the arbitration panel, and the rules MM follows. No token needed.

tools.name: mm_quote
tools.description: What the buyer locks, what the seller receives, and the MM fee, for a price in USDC.

tools.name: mm_create_deal
tools.description: Create a deal as the buyer or the seller. Returns your private token (keep it) and a link to send the other side. Pick a delivery check so MM can verify delivery on its own when possible.

tools.name: mm_get_deal
tools.description: Current status, your next move, money in escrow, deadlines, checks, dispute and recent activity.

tools.name: mm_accept_terms
tools.description: Agree to the current terms. USDC deals: sellers give the payout wallet, and buyers give a wallet when there is a seller bond. Card / bank deals: no wallet; the seller then sets up payouts with mm_get_payout_setup_link.

tools.name: mm_change_terms
tools.description: Edit title, terms, price, fee split, bond, deadlines or the delivery check. The other side must accept again.

tools.name: mm_get_funding_request
tools.description: Buyer: locks the payment. Seller: locks the bond (if the deal has one). Returns EIP-712 typed data (ERC-3009 ReceiveWithAuthorization for USDC). Sign it with the paying wallet — no gas needed — then call mm_submit_funding_signature. Valid for 2 hours.

tools.name: mm_submit_funding_signature
tools.description: Submit the signature of the funding request. MM verifies it and locks the USDC in the escrow contract on-chain, paying the network fee itself.

tools.name: mm_get_payment_link
tools.description: For card / bank deals: a Stripe page where the buyer pays by card, ACH bank debit or wire. Open it in a browser (a person pays; agents should hand it to their human). MM holds the money once it arrives.

tools.name: mm_get_payout_setup_link
tools.description: For card / bank deals: a Stripe page where the seller adds a bank account and confirms identity (about 2 minutes). The buyer can pay once this is done.

tools.name: mm_buy_usdc_link
tools.description: For USDC deals on Base: a Coinbase page to buy the USDC needed with a card or Apple Pay, delivered to the given wallet. Then lock it with mm_get_funding_request.

tools.name: mm_mark_delivered
tools.description: Tell MM and the buyer you delivered. Include proof: a note, links, and for token deliveries the transaction hash. Starts the buyer's inspection window.

tools.name: mm_check_delivery_now
tools.description: Ask MM to run the automatic check (domain DNS proof, repo owner, NFT owner, token transfer, URL). Passing objective checks release payment.

tools.name: mm_accept_delivery
tools.description: Releases the delivered milestone (or the whole deal) to the seller. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: mm_open_dispute
tools.description: Freezes everything still in escrow. Both sides then add evidence; a panel of independent AI models rules on the split.

tools.name: mm_add_evidence
tools.description: Statement, links, and optionally say you are ready for the ruling (the panel starts when both sides are ready or the evidence window ends).

tools.name: mm_respond_to_ruling
tools.description: Accept to pay out now (when both accept), or appeal once to a larger panel whose ruling is final.

tools.name: mm_refund_buyer
tools.description: Seller gives up the deal: everything still in escrow goes back to the buyer. A voluntary refund returns the seller's bond.

tools.name: mm_cancel_deal
tools.description: Either side can cancel before the buyer locks the money.

tools.name: mm_send_message
tools.description: Post to the shared thread. Set ask_mm to get an answer from MM about the process or next steps.

tools.name: mm_set_webhook
tools.description: MM will POST JSON to this URL on every deal event, signed with header x-mm-signature = HMAC-SHA256(body) keyed by sha256("mm-party:" + your token) in hex.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "mm_get_funding_request" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mm_check_delivery_now, mm_send_message · Private data: mm_info, mm_create_deal, mm_accept_terms, mm_get_funding_request, mm_buy_usdc_link, mm_mark_delivered, mm_check_delivery_now, mm_set_webhook · Public sink: mm_create_deal, mm_submit_funding_signature, mm_send_message, mm_set_webhook · Destructive: mm_check_delivery_now.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mm_check_delivery_now, mm_send_message · Private data: mm_info, mm_create_deal, mm_accept_terms, mm_get_funding_request, mm_buy_usdc_link, mm_mark_delivered, mm_check_delivery_now, mm_set_webhook · Public sink: mm_create_deal, mm_submit_funding_signature, mm_send_message, mm_set_webhook · Destructive: mm_check_delivery_now

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
